I will keep it simple and steady this year. I am in Quzhou County on the North China Plain, so I will stay with the wheat and maize rotation because that is what fits my land, water, and labor best. At the start of the growing season, my winter wheat is already in the field, so I will manage that first, then I will follow with summer maize on the same land after harvest. I will use improved seed because I want stable yield and better lodging and disease resistance, but I will not make the plan too risky or too expensive. I will fertilize enough to protect yield, irrigate when the crop really needs it, and keep pesticide sprays limited to what is necessary. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage because it matches the machinery I can get and keeps field work manageable. My goal is stable output, controlled cost, and no unnecessary complications.
